description: This file is a Swift extension for the ChannelsSettings class, providing SwiftUI view components and UI logic related to channel configurations such as WhatsApp and Telegram, including login, logout, refresh, and configuration sections.

methods.name: formSection
methods.description: Creates a styled section with a title wrapping SwiftUI content.

methods.name: channelHeaderActions
methods.description: Provides a horizontal stack of action buttons for channel-specific tasks like logout and refresh.

methods.name: whatsAppSection
methods.description: Constructs the UI for WhatsApp-specific settings and login QR code display.

methods.name: genericChannelSection
methods.description: Builds a UI section for a generic channel's configuration editor.

methods.name: configEditorSection
methods.description: Provides configuration editing controls with save, reload, and status messages.

methods.name: configStatusMessage
methods.description: Displays the current configuration status message, if any.
